MA Plot for Differential Expression/Accessibility Results

Source: R/aether_differential_plots.R
AETHER_plot_ma.Rd

Creates a four-category MA plot (log2 fold change vs log2 mean expression) with embedded counts in the legend and optional gene labeling.

Usage

AETHER_plot_ma(
  dea_result,
  label_col = NULL,
  genes_of_interest = NULL,
  label_top_n = 0,
  filter_choice = "padj",
  l2fc_thresh = 1,
  p_thresh = 0.05,
  title = "MA Plot",
  colors = NULL,
  point_size = 0.8,
  point_alpha = 0.7
)

Arguments

dea_result

A data.frame of DEA results, or a list with a $results element (as returned by ARTEMIS_perform_dea()). Required columns: baseMean, log2FoldChange, and the column named by filter_choice.

label_col

Character. Column to use for point labels. If NULL, auto-selects gene_name if present, otherwise feature_id.

genes_of_interest

Character vector. Values in label_col to label. Default: NULL.

label_top_n

Integer. Label the top N features by filter_choice. Default: 0 (disabled).

filter_choice

Column for significance filtering: "padj" or "pvalue". Default: "padj".

l2fc_thresh

Numeric. log2 fold change threshold. Default: 1.

p_thresh

Numeric. Significance threshold. Default: 0.05.

title

Character. Plot title. Default: "MA Plot".

colors

Named character vector with colors for "up", "down", "low_reg", "non_sig". Default uses red/blue/green/gray.

point_size

Numeric. Point size. Default: 0.8.

point_alpha

Numeric. Point transparency. Default: 0.7.

Value

A ggplot object.

Details

X-axis is log2(baseMean + 1). Y-axis is log2FoldChange. A solid red line marks y = 0. Dashed black lines mark ±l2fc_thresh. Non-significant points are drawn first (background) with significant points on top.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
p <- AETHER_plot_ma(dea_result, title = "KO vs WT")

p <- AETHER_plot_ma(dea_result, label_top_n = 10,
                    genes_of_interest = c("SMUG1", "OGG1"))
} # }
